QuantAgentState.title: QuantAgentState
QuantAgentState.description: Persisted state for an autonomous quantitative execution agent across Kalshi CLOB v2 and Public.com Event Contracts. Metrics and status fields (status, sharpe, winRate, totalPnlUsd) are server-written only via Firebase Admin SDK.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the portfolio owner.

status.description: Server-managed execution status of the agent (Admin SDK only).

allocatedCapitalUsd.description: Total USD capital allocated to this agent (capped <= 1000 in rules and validated server-side against live account balances).

kalshiAllocatedUsd.description: Direct Kalshi CLOB v2 cash allocation in USD (capped <= 500 in rules and validated server-side).

publicAllocatedUsd.description: Public.com buying power allocation in USD (capped <= 500 in rules and validated server-side).

sharpe.description: Server-computed realized Sharpe ratio (Admin SDK only).

winRate.description: Server-computed realized win rate percentage (Admin SDK only).

totalPnlUsd.description: Server-computed cumulative PnL in USD (Admin SDK only).

QuantVaultCheckpoint.title: QuantVaultCheckpoint
QuantVaultCheckpoint.description: Synchronized cloud checkpoint of dual-venue agent allocations, OCO orders, and telemetry calibration metrics.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

topAgentAllocatedUsd.description: Total USD allocated to top agent.

kalshiDirectUsd.description: USD allocated on Kalshi CLOB v2 Direct.

publicEventContractUsd.description: USD allocated on Public.com Event Contracts.

duckDbSettledRows.description: Settled outcome rows in telemetry ledger.

SystemKillSwitchState.title: SystemKillSwitchState
SystemKillSwitchState.description: Global emergency kill switch and execution mode flag persisted in Firestore (/system_controls/kill_switch) and checked before every order execution path.

globalKillSwitchActive.description: When true, blocks all order execution across all venues.

reason.description: Reason for the current kill-switch state.

updatedBy.description: UID or system component that last updated the kill switch.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/quant_agents/{agentId}.description: Stores autonomous agent configurations. Server-written via Admin SDK; owners may only update name, targetSymbol, and capped allocations when not in KILLED_BY_RISK or HALTED_BY_KILL_SWITCH.

/quant_vault_checkpoints/{checkpointId}.description: Stores cloud persistence checkpoints of dual-venue agent state.

/system_controls/{controlId}.description: Stores global kill switch and execution mode flags checked before every order execution path.
